metadata.title: MPAS quasi-uniform x1.2562 (N=2562 cells, ~240 km)
metadata.description: MPAS Voronoi mesh with 2562 cells, 7680 edges, max_edges=6. Quasi-uniform global sphere; 12 pentagons + 2550 hexagons. Loader path is repo-relative; supply reader_fn(path) -> MpasMeshData at bind time (NetCDF I/O not bundled per GRIDS_API.md §10).
